svg.title: What opm does
svg.desc: Animated overview in five steps: 1. describe presentation in a TEI ODD, which opm compiles into Python; 2. transform TEI, DocBook or JATS into HTML, PDF via Typst, EPUB, Word, Markdown or JSON; 3. chunk collections into pages with table of contents, breadcrumbs and notes; 4. generate a static edition website with templates, themes and profiles for IIIF facsimiles, registers, Pagefind search and edition navigation; 5. feed other systems: static site generators, TEI Publisher, search indexes and ODD documentation.

g.text: A whole collection becomes a website
Give the site its look and features
… or hand the results to other systems
data files for static site generators
JSONL records for any search engine
